description: This file provides Windows-specific compatibility utilities for a Git-related project, including path validation, UTF-8/UTF-16 conversions, SSL setup wrappers, and platform-specific checks. It contains inline functions, macro definitions, and function declarations to facilitate cross-platform compatibility on Windows.

methods.name: mingw_core_config
methods.description: Configures platform-specific settings based on variables and context.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_fd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Sets the SSL file descriptor using Windows handle conversion.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_rfd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Sets the read SSL file descriptor using Windows handle conversion.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_wfd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Sets the write SSL file descriptor using Windows handle conversion.

methods.name: void convert_slashes(char * path)
methods.description: Converts Windows backslash path separators to Unix forward slashes.

methods.name: mingw_query_user_email
methods.description: Retrieves the email of the current user.

methods.name: is_path_owned_by_current_sid
methods.description: Checks if a path is owned by the current user SID.

methods.name: is_valid_win32_path
methods.description: Validates whether a path is valid on Windows, checking for reserved characters, names, and format.

methods.name: xutftowcsn
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to wide-character string, handling invalid sequences.

methods.name: int xutftowcs(wchar_t * wcs,const char * utf,size_t wcslen)
methods.description: Simplified UTF-8 to wide-character conversion assuming null-terminated input.

methods.name: int xutftowcs_path(wchar_t * wcs,const char * utf)
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to wide-character string with Maximum path length, handling errors.

methods.name: xwcstoutf
methods.description: Converts wide-character string to UTF-8, handling invalid surrogate pairs and encoding errors.

methods.name: wmain
methods.description: Wmain Unicode entry point, converts arguments from UTF-16 to UTF-8.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Standard C entry point for the application.

methods.name: open_in_gdb
methods.description: Launches GDB attached to the current process for debugging.

methods.name: err_win_to_posix
methods.description: Maps Windows error codes to POSIX error codes for compatibility.

ctags.name: xutftowcs
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int xutftowcs(wchar_t *wcs, const char *utf, size_t wcslen)$/
